newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0800 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Weak cash markets but evening up seen ahead of Cattle-on-Feed Report.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady. CME index up but corn seen higher and easier fed cattle prices may limit demand.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.300 cent. Carryover seen on steady to higher cash hog calls and reduced runs.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.500 to off 0.300 cents. Carryover likely from limit advance but market also looks overbought.
